article.title: Connor Hellebuyck traded to New Jersey as Winnipeg Jets end bitter standoff with US Olympic hero

article.content: Three-time Vezina winner leaves Winnipeg after 11 years Devils send four players and two draft picks to Jets Olympic gold medalist joins US teammate Jack Hughes Connor Hellebuyck finally has a new home after the Winnipeg Jets granted the three-time Vezina Trophy-winning goaltender’s trade request in a deal that sent him to the New Jersey Devils on Friday. The Devils sent center Dawson Mercer, goalie Nico Daws, prospect Alexander Command, forward Nick Bjugstad, a 2029 second-round pick and a 2027 seventh-rounder to Winnipeg for Hellebuyck.
